text: Learning a new skill takes time and effort. First, you need to practise regularly, even for just a few minutes each day. Patience is also important because you will not become an expert overnight. There are many resources that can help you, such as online videos, books, and classes. It is a good idea to track your progress so you can see how much you have improved. Finally, stay motivated by reminding yourself why you started and by celebrating small successes along the way.
